findings: Aggregator split (single file was 505 lines): electron/deployment-full-details.ts (321 lines: DeploymentDetailsClients, fetchDeploymentFullDetails, toPlain, summarizePod, filterHpa, toDeploymentEvent, filterOwned, pickPodMetrics) + electron/deployment-full-details-fetchers.ts (215 lines: classifyK8sError, settle/SettleOptions, mapWithConcurrency, summarizeNode, toSaSummary, toPvcSummary, fetchNodes, fetchPvcs, shortMessage). The main file re-exports the fetchers' public helpers so every design export is importable from './deployment-full-details'; no import cycle. Wiring: K8sService.getDeploymentFullDetails added right after getDeploymentRevisions (clients built inside withAuthRetry; logs ns/name once); safeHandle('k8s:getDeploymentFullDetails', z.tuple([...]) with the exact §3.5 schema added right after the k8s:getDeploymentRevisions handler; mutation-policy classify() returns READ by default (no MUTATE pattern matches), nothing added. preload method next to getDeploymentRevisions; typings added next to getReplicaSet in electron/electron-env.d.ts and src/vite-env.d.ts via inline import('…/types/deployment-details').DeploymentFullDetailsResponse (getDeploymentRevisions is not declared in either d.ts). Deviations/notes for later FEATs: (1) CoreV1Event has no reportingController field (core/v1 calls it reportingComponent), so event source = source.component ?? reportingComponent ?? null. (2) toDeploymentEvent takes an optional 2nd arg fetchedAt (default now) for the lastTimestamp fallback. (3) classifyK8sError checks numeric status (first numeric of code/statusCode/response.statusCode) before the message-only 401 regex, so a 403 whose text mentions 'Unauthorized' stays 'forbidden'. (4) 'other' error messages use the K8s Status body.message when present, else the first line of err.message (client-node ApiException messages embed body+headers), truncated to 300 chars. (5) Phase-1 messages: not-found 'Deployment <ns>/<name> not found', forbidden 'No permission to read deployment <ns>/<name>'. Section forbidden messages are '<label>: forbidden' with labels replicasets, pods, events, services, ingresses, networkpolicies, hpas, pdbs, serviceaccount, namespace, metrics; nodes forbidden = 'No permission to read nodes'; PVCs all-forbidden = 'pvcs: forbidden'. (6) PVCs/nodes where every read fails (not forbidden) -> status 'error' with the first failure message; partial -> ok + 'N of M PVC|node reads failed'. (7) displayStatus order: Terminating, main waiting reason, main terminated reason, 'Init:<reason>' for a waiting init/sidecar (excluding PodInitializing), else phase. Verification: electron/deployment-full-details.test.ts 28 tests pass (all plan cases incl. Secret-spy over every CoreV1Api.prototype *Secret* method, 401 numeric + message-only, uid ownership, multi-byte lastAppliedBytes, node 403 stop <=8 calls, 40 hanging reads deadline with no new readNode after 20 s, PVCs read in phase 2 while nodes hang). Full vitest 39 files / 339 tests pass; tsc exit 0; eslint --max-warnings 0 clean on the 3 new files; the 5 modified files stay at the 767 pre-existing problems (no new ones); npx vite build succeeds. Not committed.
